title: Panel state
description:
Panel state and callbacks: `store` keeps values between refreshes, `dbdash.run()`
runs the query again with other arguments, and `meta` has the run records. Runs Lua,
so it asks for trust first. See `:help dbdash-callback`.

query.sql:
{% if args.days > 30 %}{% set args.days = 30 %}{% endif %}
SELECT {{ args.days }} * 100 + abs(random() % 50) AS orders

show.title: Orders, change since the last refresh
show.description: The change of the orders since the last refresh, kept in `store`.

show.title: Twice as long: from query.transform
show.description:
`dbdash.run({ days = ... })` from `query.transform`: the same query with another
argument, its rows used in this result.

query.sql:
SELECT {{ args.days }} AS days, {{ args.days }} * 100 + abs(random() % 50) AS orders,
{% lua %}
  if meta.run.kind == "callback" then return "NULL" end   -- the callback leaves it empty
  return dbdash.run({ days = args.days * 2 }).rows[1][2]
{% endlua %} AS orders_2x

show.title: Twice as long: from {% lua %} in query.sql
show.description: The same callback from a {% raw %}`{% lua %}`{% endraw %} block in `query.sql`.

show.title: Twice as long: from an imported module
show.description: The same callback from a function of an imported module (`modules/callbacks.lua`).

show.title: History kept in store (last 20 refreshes)
show.description: `store` keeps the last 20 values; the line shows them.

query.sql:
-- A refresh with two callbacks; the table lists the previous refresh's life
-- (meta.prev_runs): its records, with ids, callers and times (the current life on
-- the first refresh, still running).
if meta.run.kind == "callback" then return { { days = args.days } } end
dbdash.run({ days = args.days })
dbdash.run({ days = args.days * 2 })
local short = function(id) return id and id:sub(1, 8) .. "…" .. id:sub(-4) or "" end
local rows = {}
for _, r in ipairs(meta.prev_runs or meta.runs) do
  rows[#rows + 1] = { short(r.id), r.kind, r.depth, short(r.parent_id), r.args.days,
                      r.elapsed_ms or "", r.ok == nil and "…" or tostring(r.ok) }
end
return { columns = { "id", "kind", "depth", "parent", "days", "ms", "ok" }, rows = rows }

show.title: Run records of the previous refresh (meta.prev_runs)
show.description:
`meta.prev_runs`: the run records of the previous refresh (ids, kinds, times,
results).

query.sql:
-- Callbacks of callbacks: every level runs the query again with twice the days
-- until meta.run.depth is 3, so the refresh (depth 0) has a chain of three
-- callbacks; it lists every level of its life (meta.runs).
if meta.run.depth < 3 then
  dbdash.run({ days = args.days * 2 })
end
if meta.run.kind == "callback" then
  return { { days = args.days } }
end
local rows = {}
for _, r in ipairs(meta.runs) do
  rows[#rows + 1] = { r.depth, r.kind, r.args.days, r.ok == nil and "…" or tostring(r.ok) }
end
return { columns = { "depth", "kind", "days", "ok" }, rows = rows }

show.title: Callbacks of callbacks, stopped at meta.run.depth 3
show.description:
Callbacks that call themselves stop at `meta.run.depth` 3 (and at
`lua.max_callback_depth`).
